integrity: The general equivalence is proved directly from the defining identity. The S3 counts are derived structurally from conjugation-orbit decompositions of the four possible generated-image subgroup types. A standalone exhaustive checker independently tests all 46656 set maps and all automorphism orbits.
scientific_limitations: The exact census concerns Das's conjugation-based definition of a group averaging operator and should not be conflated with later stronger identities using A(g)A(h)=A(A(g)h)=A(gA(h)).
The numerical classification is specific to S3; only the subgroup-equivariance criterion is general.
A specialized or unindexed finite-group calculation may contain an equivalent census.
title: The symmetric group \(S_3\) has \(129\) averaging maps and \(51\) pointed ones
